title: The independent ordered affine integration constructions
statement: In the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], for the ordered affine tower over a separated finite-type k-scheme Y [def-pur-affine-space-comparison], construct the ordinary ordered trace as the counit at the coefficient unit of the ordered ordinary affine adjunction [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], transported along equality of the recursive tower models. Realize this trace through the specified compact-support site comparison [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. For a bounded-below K with a retained ordinary constructible finite-Tor representative, its integration augmentation is inverse canonical compactification projection, then 1_K tensor the realized trace, then the coefficient unitor. Its integrationTranspose is the specified exceptional Hom transpose precomposed with the explicit ordered-source comparison; at dimension zero it is the identity. The source comparisons, antecedents, source/stage applicability, and the line maps at both the source and actual exceptional target retain their existing constructions. All endpoint choices are from unique HEq specifications, not arbitrary orientations.
